'''Coruscant Military Command''', or simply '''Coruscant Command''', was part of the command structure of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Military]]. Around [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], they dispatched the [[Katarn Commandos]] to [[Vorrnti City]] to aid [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], a former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]].
